failure_modes.mode: Wrong jobs selected or deleted across filter/country changes
failure_modes.cause: Select-all scope unclear or async country mutation
failure_modes.mitigation: Select all shown only; explicit snapshot of IDs/count/titles; captured country checked before preview and delete; existing server country/ownership validation

failure_modes.detection: Bulk mixed eligible/blocked browser tests and existing lifecycle unit tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Fresh preview and token for each job; retain server active/browser/pipeline/uncertain checks; report skipped records

failure_modes.effect: Lost CV or another job's files
failure_modes.detection: Batch shared-file/original preservation test with real existing endpoints
failure_modes.mitigation: Reuse existing retire and cleanup unchanged; each subsequent preview reflects remaining references

failure_modes.mode: Partial completion or lost response misreported as success
failure_modes.detection: Partial failure, cancellation and transport-error tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Per-record results, no automatic retries, bounded requests, refresh after completion and explicit summary

failure_modes.mode: Unwanted redirect or lost remaining selection
failure_modes.cause: Existing navigate(history) and blanket selection reset
failure_modes.effect: Repeated navigation and poor bulk recovery
failure_modes.detection: Single/bulk browser navigation and failed-selection checks
failure_modes.mitigation: Return to Jobs; remove confirmed deleted IDs and prune disappeared records; keep remaining selections
